FISHING LICENCE · BHUTAN

Bhutan fishing licence

Visitors need a fishing permit for the approved water and dates. Foreign anglers must use a Bhutanese fishing guide and release their catch.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Foreign visitors who fish in approved recreational waters.

Fishing with a guide or charter

A Bhutanese fishing guide is compulsory for foreign anglers. Each angler must appear on the permit application.

Rules visitors should know

  • Release each fish immediately.
  • Use an artificial fly or lure with one single barbless hook.

How to buy

Apply through Online Forestry Services. Enter your passport number, fishing area and start date.
